title: Home Membership Brand (Working Name: Home Record)
brands: Home maintenance membership: photo onboarding, AI system labels, monthly tech visits, the Home Record; US pilot, licensed to a Thai company
Base: light cream, black/white/grey, Khand/Hind; explainer accent muted teal #4F8A8B vs terracotta, lagoon, jungle

feelings.system: Calm, organized system for your home
feelings.concierge: Premium concierge for your house (quiet quality)

dropped_conflicts.Tended: Tended (tendedhome.com, Westwood KS) sells a home maintenance membership; also usetended.com maintenance reports
dropped_conflicts.Home Ledger: HomeLedger home maintenance app (App Store, homeledger.app)
dropped_conflicts.House Tune: HomeTune preventive home maintenance subscription, Louisville KY
dropped_conflicts.Steady / Steady House: Steady Home Maintenance memberships, Flowood MS
dropped_conflicts.Kindred Home: Kindred Home Support home maintenance service
dropped_conflicts.Housemark: Housemark homebuying AI (housemark.io) and UK housing inspections app

name_check.note: Survivors passed a quick check only (no clear same-name US home-services brand or app found; .com not an obvious active business). EVERY survivor still needs a real USPTO/TESS trademark search and a domain purchase check before use. 'Home Record' is crowded (Home Record Keeper app, houserecordapp.com, homerecord.com active energy-software business): keep it as the in-app feature name, not the company name.
